patch.summary:
Thesis: Same category, different company size — Both sit in ecommerce, but documented company-size audiences diverge.

Comparison thesis: Same category, different company size. Choose Saleor only if your buying job matches “Headless GraphQL commerce — OSS self-host free; Cloud Select $1599/mo, Volume $3999/mo, En” rather than Webflow's shape. Choose Webflow only if your buying job matches “Design-led website platform with Ecommerce — Standard $29/mo (500 items, 2% fee), Plus $74” rather than Saleor's shape. Workflow advantage: Saleor leans shared coverage; Webflow leans website-builder-commerce. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Same category, different company size — Both sit in ecommerce, but documented company-size audiences diverge.
- Positioning: Saleor is Headless GraphQL commerce — OSS self-host free; Cloud Select $1599/mo, Volume $3999/mo, Enterprise quote. Forever Free is non-commercial onl; Webflow is Design-led website platform with Ecommerce — Standard $29/mo (500 items, 2% fee), Plus $74 highlighted (5,000 items, 0% fee), Advanced $212 .
- Company-size focus: Saleor (mid-market, enterprise) vs Webflow (solo, micro, small-business).
- Workflow coverage skew: Saleor-leaning — vs Webflow-leaning website-builder-commerce.
- Researched limits: Saleor — Cloud Select floor ($1599/mo) is high versus WooCommerce hosting TCO; Webflow — Ecommerce requires a Site plan in addition to the Ecommerce plan — model combined TCO, not the $29 floor alone.

Limitations — Saleor: Cloud Select floor ($1599/mo) is high versus WooCommerce hosting TCO; Forever Free Cloud is non-commercial — not a production merchant free plan; Webflow: Ecommerce requires a Site plan in addition to the Ecommerce plan — model combined TCO, not the $29 floor alone; Catalog caps (500 / 5,000 / 15,000 items) and Standard’s 2% transaction fee trail Shopify-class commerce OS depth.

Poor-fit cases: Saleor is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Cloud Select floor ($1599/mo) is high versus WooCommerce hosting TCO · Webflow is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Ecommerce requires a Site plan in addition to the Ecommerce plan — model combined TCO, not the $29 floor alone · Avoid Saleor if you actually need Webflow's motion (Design-led website platform with Ecommerce — Standard $29/mo (500 items, 2% fee))

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
